objective.ride_available: Ride request waiting, check your phone
objective.negotiate: Agree a fare with the passenger
objective.no_show: Passenger didn't show, look for a new ride
objective.cancelled: Ride cancelled, look for a new ride
objective.failed: The ride couldn't be completed, look for a new ride
hud.fuel_empty: Tank empty! Push the bike or call for help
hud.bike_warn: Bike in poor shape, visit a garage
objective.charge_phone: Phone is dead: charge it at home or a tea stall, or pick up passengers hailing on the street
objective.app_suspended: The app is suspended: take direct or street passengers until it is back
objective.no_route: No road left to the destination, the ride was cancelled. Look for a new ride
